title: ほどいて、どっちが長い？
concept: くねくねした糸とうず巻きの糸を見比べ、長いほうを目分量で選ぶ。答えると二本がまっすぐ伸び、見た目の広がりと本当の長さの違いが分かる。八問の中で見る場所を変え、最後には少し見抜けるようになる感覚を核にした。
howToPlay: 長いと思う糸のA・Bをタップ。答え合わせで糸が伸びたら、画面をタップして次へ。全8問。
libraryDecision: 曲線と伸ばした長さの対応を正確に見せるためCanvasで線分列を描く。物理や3Dの揺れ・遠近は長さ比較を曖昧にするので使わない。
soundDecision: 正解には高い二音、不正解には低い短音を添える。形の観察を妨げないようBGMは入れない。

candidates.idea: 曲がった二本の糸の長さを当て、回答後に伸ばして見比べる目分量クイズ。
candidates.ideaEn: Estimate which curved thread is longer, then unroll both to compare.

candidates.idea: 磁石を置いて鋼の玉を曲げ、届かないポケットへ運ぶビリヤード。
candidates.ideaEn: Place magnets to bend steel balls toward unreachable billiard pockets.

candidates.idea: 花びらの透明色を重ね、注文の色の花束を作る。
candidates.ideaEn: Overlap translucent petals to mix requested bouquet colors.

en.title: Unroll: Which Is Longer?
en.concept: Compare a wavy thread and a spiral and estimate which is longer. After answering, both straighten out to reveal the difference between visual spread and actual length. Across eight questions, change what you look for and develop a better eye.
en.howToPlay: Tap A or B for the longer thread. After they straighten, tap anywhere to continue. Eight questions.
en.libraryDecision: Canvas polylines preserve the exact connection between curved and straight lengths. Physics wobble and perspective would obscure comparison, so neither is used.
en.soundDecision: Two higher tones mark correct answers; a short low tone marks mistakes. No music distracts from examining the shapes.

aiReview.comment: 8手を画像で確認し4問回答。最初の3問は目分量で正解し、4問目は意図的に短いBを選んで不正解と点数据え置きを確認した。曲がった糸が伸びて答えになる反応は分かりやすい。渦巻き同士は大きい方が長い出題が続き、形の種類も二つなので、驚きは控えめ。8問後の結果・再開には未到達。

similar.title: The Eyeballing Game
similar.note: 図形を目分量で判断し、正しい幾何と比較する点が近い。本作は位置を調整する操作ではなく、曲線の長さの二択と直線への変形に絞る。
similar.note_en: Both estimate geometry and compare against the correct result. This game replaces position adjustment with a two-choice curve-length comparison and straightening.

aiReview.research: Web検索を3件実施。視覚テストとExploratoriumの調査は長さ比較ゲームの具体例に不足。The Eyeballing Gameの作者による説明で、目分量と正しい図形を見比べる規則を確認した。

en.comment: Viewed eight steps and answered four questions. Estimated the first three correctly; deliberately chose shorter B on question four to confirm incorrect feedback and unchanged score. Unrolling makes the answer readable. Spiral comparisons repeatedly favored the visibly larger one, and only two shape families limit surprise. Did not reach the eight-question result or restart.
en.research: Ran three web searches. Visual-test and Exploratorium results lacked a specific length-comparison game. Verified estimation and correct-geometry feedback in the creator’s description of The Eyeballing Game.

aiReview.method: スマホ縦画面で 8 手プレイ（時間を止めて1手ずつ操作）
aiReview.methodEn: Played 8 moves on a portrait phone screen (time frozen between moves)

playLog.note: 長い糸を選び、伸ばして確かめる説明を読んで開始する。
playLog.noteEn: Read the estimate-and-unroll instructions and start.

playLog.note: 二本とも渦巻き。Aのほうが外へ大きく回って長そうなのでAを選ぶ。
playLog.noteEn: Both are spirals. A sweeps farther outward and looks longer, so choose A.

playLog.note: A63、B56で正解。直線の長さの差が分かる。次の形を見る。
playLog.noteEn: A63 versus B56: correct. The straight lines show the difference. Continue.

playLog.note: Aの外周が大きく、巻き数は似ている。今回もAが長いと予想する。
playLog.noteEn: A has a larger outer sweep with a similar turn count. Guess A again.

playLog.note: 第二問もA61対B56だった。次は波形との違いも見たい。
playLog.noteEn: Second answer was A61 versus B56. Continue to compare more shapes.

playLog.note: Aは縦に長い波形だが、Bは大きく何周も巻く。糸の総量はBが長そう。
playLog.noteEn: A spreads vertically, but B winds several broad turns. Guess B has more total thread.

playLog.note: B61対A43。広がりだけでなく巻きの回数を見ると当てやすい。次へ。
playLog.noteEn: B61 versus A43. Turn count matters more than spread. Continue.

playLog.note: Aが大きく長そうだが、不正解表示も確かめるためBを選ぶ。
playLog.noteEn: A looks larger and longer; deliberately choose B to inspect incorrect-answer feedback.

metrics.method: Codexのtoken_usage_recordをresponse_idで重複除去し企画開始から自己判定完了まで集計。入力はキャッシュ込み、出力から思考を控除。ツールはトップレベル呼出のみ。
metrics.methodEn: Aggregated Codex token_usage_record entries by unique response_id from planning through review. Input includes cached tokens; output excludes reasoning. Tools count top-level calls only.
